theorem Farc_le {L : ℕ} [NeZero L] {a : ℕ → ℂ} {δ₀ Q₀ Q x β C : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hQ₀ : 1 ≤ Q₀)
    (hQQ : Q₀ ≤ Q) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C)
    (hC : ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → Even q → (q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q₀ → ∀ s : ℝ, 1 ≤ s → s ≤ 2 * Q₀ / q →
      Gq q (2 * Q₀ / (s * q)) ≤ C * Gq q (2 * Q / (s * q)))
    (hqL₀ : ∀ q ∈ Qset Q₀, q ∣ L) (hqL : ∀ q ∈ Qset Q, q ∣ L) (ha : Summable fun n => ‖a n‖)
    (hcop : ∀ n, a n ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime n L) :
    Farc a δ₀ Q₀ x β ≤ C * Farc a δ₀ Q x β :=

note: As [H] Proposition 12.1.2, up to notation. Lean needs δ0 ≥ 2 (for 2Q ≤ √x, because its common modulus includes odd q ∈ (Q, 2Q]); the book's δ0 ≥ 1 is sound, and both applications use δ0 ≥ 8. prop_12_1_2 now carries no hypotheses.
